tools.name: generate_dental_treatment_plan_pdf
tools.description: Start the real Toofi headless treatment-plan pipeline from structured clinical findings: create a service-user runtime plan, invoke AI plan generation, and return an operation id for polling toward a patient-facing PDF output.

tools.name: get_dental_plan_operation_status
tools.description: Poll a Toofi headless treatment-plan operation until AI planning is completed and ready for presentation/PDF delivery.

tools.name: discover_capabilities
tools.description: Discover Toofi agent-native dental planning capabilities, links, safety boundary, and billing rails.

tools.name: lookup_dental_procedures
tools.description: Map a natural-language dental procedure query to structured Toofi procedure catalog entries and pricing anchors. No PHI.

tools.name: preview_plan_draft_schema
tools.description: Preview the structured Toofi treatment-plan draft response schema for agent-native clinical workflows.

tools.name: generate_treatment_plan_draft
tools.description: Generate a structured no-memory Toofi treatment-plan draft with visits, estimate, presentation outline, billing metadata, audit receipt shape, and dentist approval boundary.

tools.name: list_demo_patients
tools.description: List public no-PHI Toofi demo patients so agents can inspect patient response structure.

tools.name: get_demo_patient
tools.description: Get one public no-PHI Toofi demo patient.

tools.name: list_demo_plans
tools.description: List public no-PHI Toofi demo treatment plans.

tools.name: get_demo_plan
tools.description: Get one public no-PHI Toofi demo treatment plan with estimate and dentist approval boundary.

tools.name: get_demo_presentation
tools.description: Get one public no-PHI Toofi demo patient presentation shape with provenance surface fields.

tools.name: get_example_result
tools.description: Return a stable public PDF artifact that shows what Toofi produces: a patient-facing treatment-plan presentation for an example case where tooth 11 and root 11 are missing. No generation is run at call time.

tools.name: example_en
tools.description: Return the cached English Toofi example PDF artifact. Same as example-en for human docs; MCP-safe tool name uses underscore.

tools.name: example_ru
tools.description: Return the cached Russian Toofi example PDF artifact. Same as example-ru for human docs; MCP-safe tool name uses underscore.

tools.name: example_uk
tools.description: Return the cached Ukrainian Toofi example PDF artifact.

tools.name: example_ua
tools.description: Return the cached Ukrainian Toofi example PDF artifact using the ua alias requested by agent integrators.

tools.name: example_pl
tools.description: Return the cached Polish Toofi example PDF artifact.

tools.name: example_sk
tools.description: Return the cached Slovak Toofi example PDF artifact.

tools.name: generate_patient_presentation
tools.description: Generate a patient-facing Toofi presentation from a treatment plan with signed audit and C2PA-provenanced output surface.

tools.name: generate_price_estimate
tools.description: Generate a Toofi price estimate from treatment-plan and clinic pricing inputs.

tools.name: start_pano_markup
tools.description: Start Toofi panoramic X-ray markup workflow under agent-native clinical planning rails.

tools.name: import_price_csv
tools.description: Import and map a clinic price CSV into Toofi pricing configuration.

tools.name: get_agent_credit_balance
tools.description: Get Toofi internal credit balance for an agent or clinic mandate.

tools.name: list_audit_receipts
tools.description: List signed Toofi agent invocation receipts and provenance records.

tools.name: list_patients
tools.description: List clinic patients through Toofi agent-native mandate rails.

tools.name: get_patient
tools.description: Get one clinic patient through Toofi agent-native mandate rails.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List Toofi treatment plans through agent-native mandate rails.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Get one Toofi treatment plan through agent-native mandate rails.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get Toofi agent workflow status.

tools.name: get_agent_billing_quote
tools.description: Get a deterministic Toofi internal-credit quote for an agent tool call, including TTL, payment rails, Stripe checkout command, and x402-ready contract fields.

tools.name: create_agent_checkout_session
tools.description: Create a real Stripe Checkout session for buying Toofi internal credits. Returns a claim token so the agent can retrieve its key after payment.

tools.name: claim_agent_checkout_key
tools.description: After Stripe Checkout is paid, exchange the purchase id and one-time claim token for the Toofi agent API key used as X-Toofi-Agent-Key or agent_key.
